tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Shopify: color scheme 'Background'. Moda: warm paper. Joias: near-white, so metal and stones carry the color. Móveis: linen, a step darker, like a showroom wall.

tokens.name: surface-tile
tokens.usage: Ground behind product images and image placeholders. Móveis: the rounded product card itself.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text on surface and surface-tile. Shopify: color scheme 'Text'. Moda: espresso brown. Joias: near-black. Móveis: charcoal.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, compare-at price, spec and dimension lines, footer headings. At least 4.5:1 on surface and surface-tile in every theme.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and section rules only. Never a control border (fails 3:1). Móveis: the rule between the two halves of a split heading.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of size buttons, inputs, secondary buttons, chips. Meets 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Moda: rust, sparingly. Joias: antique gold, sparingly. Móveis: oak, used as a whole panel behind light text ('Built from solid oak'), never as small text.

tokens.name: accent-label
tokens.usage: Text on an accent panel.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Shopify: color scheme 'Solid button background'.

tokens.name: button-label
tokens.usage: Primary button label. Shopify: color scheme 'Solid button label'.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Announcement bar ground. Moda and Móveis: the inverse of surface. Joias: a quiet tile tone.

tokens.name: bar-label
tokens.usage: Text on bar.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Decorative neutral: swatch rings, the cover, empty-state illustrations. Never behind text.

tokens.name: tag
tokens.usage: Joias: the paper tag laid straight across the top edge of an editorial image ('Icons', 'New'). Never rotated. Móveis: the floating product card over a room image.

tokens.name: tag-label
tokens.usage: Text on tag. Always dark: the tag is pale in every theme.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Pickup available, in stock, ready to ship. Always paired with a word, never the dot alone.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form errors and sold-out messages that block a purchase.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Giant footer wordmark, full width. Moda only: no other preset uses it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headings over images. One per page.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Product title, collection title.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Editorial captions in split blocks, card headings in look lists.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Descriptions, rich text, policy pages.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Product card name and price, cart lines, fit notes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Navigation, buttons, badges, image captions. Never for sentences.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Model is 177 cm and wears S
styles.usage: Image captions under editorial images, helper text under inputs.

styles.name: joias-display
styles.usage: The split hero headline: one half left, one half right, the second half in italic.

styles.name: joias-heading-1
styles.usage: Product title, collection title.

styles.name: joias-heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings.

styles.name: joias-italic
styles.usage: The italic half of a caption over a portrait ('Rings Collection'). Never a whole sentence in italic.

styles.name: joias-card-name
styles.usage: Product name on cards. The jewelry card names a piece in the serif; Moda uses the sans.

styles.name: joias-body
styles.sample: Cast in recycled 18k gold and polished by hand.
styles.usage: Descriptions, intro paragraphs, rich text.

styles.name: joias-spec
styles.usage: The spec line under a card name: material and one dimension. Always present on Joias cards.

styles.name: joias-price
styles.usage: Card and line-item price.

styles.name: joias-label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Category links, buttons, counters ('24 pieces').

styles.name: moveis-display
styles.usage: Uppercase. Hero headline over the room image. One per page.

styles.name: moveis-heading-1
styles.usage: Uppercase. The split section heading: first word left, second right, a hairline rule between them.

styles.name: moveis-heading-2
styles.usage: Uppercase. Panel and room headings.

styles.name: moveis-number
styles.usage: Step numbers in the craft and delivery sections.

styles.name: moveis-body
styles.sample: Kiln-dried oak, joined by hand and finished with plant oils.
styles.usage: Descriptions, panel text, rich text.

styles.name: moveis-card-name
styles.usage: Product name on cards, top-left inside the rounded card.

styles.name: moveis-spec
styles.usage: The dimension line on every card and line item. Tabular figures.

styles.name: moveis-label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Navigation, chips, buttons, small headings.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Moda: gap between images and product tiles. The near-touching grid is a signature of Moda.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges; between card image and name.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between swatches; between name and sizes on a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side margin on mobile; button padding. Móveis: the inset around the hero and between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Moda: page side margin on desktop. Joias: gap between product tiles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section. Móveis: page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile. Joias: page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop (Moda, Móveis).

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop (Joias). More air than Moda.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Moda: everything. Joias: images and tiles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Móveis: buttons, chips and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Móveis: images, product cards, panels. The soft corner of the furniture preset.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Swatches and hotspots in every preset. Joias: also every button and chip (pill buttons).
